navigationHelp: Navigate personal work and pages in the current workspace.
commandsHelp: Find pages, teams and projects in the current workspace. Use arrow keys to select, Enter to open and Escape to close.
commandSearch: Find a page, team or project
readError: Current access could not be read. Try again.
homeHelp: See assigned work and your explicitly selected workspaces together.
noFavorites: No favorites yet. Use the star on an issue, team, project or workspace.
invalid: Check your selections and query. Your draft was retained.
commandRejected: The request was rejected. The original request and draft were retained; retry is unavailable.
reviewRequired: No response was received. Review current access before retrying the same request.
snapshotHelp: These results were captured together. Opening a record reads its current state and access.
selectionHelp: Only explicitly selected workspaces are combined. Select up to {{max}}.
unavailableWorkspace: Selected workspace is no longer available — unselect
scopeLimit: The {{max}} workspace limit is reached. Unselect one before adding another.
captureUncertain: The result response was not received. You can retry the exact original query and workspace selection.
expired: These results expired. Explicitly refresh for current results; your draft was retained.
scopeChanged: Current access to the selected workspaces changed. Previous results are hidden. Review your workspace selections.
unapplied: Your changed selections are not yet applied to the displayed results.
